notes.title: Release Date!
notes.content:
Hey there!

I'm really happy to announce that Black Mountain Kings will be released on November 14th!

The game currently features:
2 major cities
2 party members
7 dungeons + 3 overworld areas
~40 different enemies
7 bosses + some mini bosses
Several side quests
48 achievements

notes.title: New version of the demo!
notes.content:
Hey there!
It's been a while, but the new demo is here!

What is new:

Overworld map
Attributes (STR, AGI, VIT, DEX, RES, INT) have a maximum value, defined by the starting class
Class descriptions
A lot of bug fixes


The game will be released in Early Access soon, so keep an eye on it!

notes.title: Important news!
notes.content:
Hey there!

It's been a while since I've posted anything related to the game's development, and I apologize for that.

In the last months I added a lot of new content to the game (new areas, enemies, items, NPCs, etc) and fixed bugs / issues, but I also made some substancial changes to the game:


Attributes (STR, AGI, VIT, DEX, RES, INT) now have a maximum possible value
The initial class determines these maximum values
It's possible to increase or decrease (!!) these maximum values


I also added a very important and necessary feature: a OVERWORLD MAP!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706220/28c0f2421bea12b852703401884e19daa208de46.png

It's very simple but it dramatically improves the experience of playing the game.



Considering these changes, I believe the current demo doesn't accurately represent the final game. So I'll release a new demo soon!

notes.title: New version of the demo!
